title: THE VOICE ON 14 MEGACYCLES
beat: Night shift. Dead frequency 14 crackles: an American mayday. Valya logs it against Section 7 — unlogged intercepts are treason. Korabelnikov demands the night log.
cliffhanger: He flips to her page: the entry is gone, a fresh ink smudge where it was. She wrote it. Who erased it?

title: THE FATHER TAPE
beat: Valya breaks down the mayday frame by frame: SEVEN-THREE's protocol errors are Soviet-trained. Someone on her side taught the American.
cliffhanger: The instructor's call sign on the training tape is her father's.

title: THE MISSING PAGE
beat: The log page didn't vanish — it was taken: her own supervisor lifted it on Moscow's orders and burned it in the stove.
cliffhanger: The supervisor is found dead at his desk. Headphones still on. The board lamp for 14 lit.

title: MOONLIGHT SONATA
beat: Korabelnikov's real orders surface: not find the leak — close the frequency, forever. He offers Valya a trade: the truth about her father for the tape.
cliffhanger: He plays her a recording: Pyotr Orlov's last transmission, 1953. The voice on it is not dying of weather.

title: THE SECOND OPERATOR
beat: Valya hunts the eraser; Riva was alone with the log. Confrontation becomes blackmail both ways: Riva heard it too — and answered.
cliffhanger: Riva plays her a scrap of tape: a woman's voice, Russian, on 14. 'That's not me. Ask your father.'

title: THE LAST SHIFT
beat: Evacuation night. Valya patches the archive field set into the Moscow trunk line: the dead speak to the Presidium's own switchboard.
cliffhanger: A voice answers from Moscow. Not security. A woman: 'We have been waiting for this call. Patch me to your father.'

title: TWO TAPES
beat: The mayday's coordinates match a cosmonaut who never flew. Valya makes a private copy of the tape and hides it in the headband crate.
cliffhanger: The hiding spot is empty — and a second headset on the rack is still warm.

title: TRAITOR'S WAVE
beat: Cornered, Riva confesses first: she has answered every mayday for eight months — a switchboard of the lost. She takes the fall for Valya's field set.
cliffhanger: Riva, being led out, leaves her headset on the rack. Inside the earcup: the hiding-tape.

title: DEAD AIR
beat: By order, the post goes dark: boards powered down, logs sealed, leave cancelled. Valya hand-cranks a buried field set in the old archive room.
cliffhanger: Static clears. SEVEN-THREE, calm now: 'They told me you'd listen. Valya.'

title: MOSCOW'S EAR
beat: Burn order: destroy the post, scatter the operators, salt the logs. Korabelnikov must choose — the order of the day, or the oath he swore in 1945.
cliffhanger: He burns the post. And leaves one crate — the headband crate — by the gate.

title: THE TRACING PARTY
beat: A team arrives to triangulate the rogue transmitter Valya is secretly keeping alive. Korabelnikov stalls them with procedure.
cliffhanger: The trace pins the transmitter — inside the perimeter. Inside the archive room.

title: ONE FREQUENCY
beat: The frequency is closed; the record is ash. Valya is reassigned to a dead-letter archive in Kazan and told to forget. Riva's charges quietly dropped; Korabelnikov promoted away.
cliffhanger: Her new desk. On it, one unlabeled tape, still warm from someone's pocket. 14 megacycles, her father's handwriting on the label.
